curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the rule that every resident driver needs a license, then the exam cutoffs for expired licenses and the short list of drivers who may go without one.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the three-year versus one-year expiry cutoffs and the thirty-day new resident window versus the ninety-day visitor limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver and asking whether an Alabama license or an exam is needed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach who Alabama refuses to license, the separate under-nineteen school rule and its enrollment form, and the authorized presence proof every original applicant gives.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each refusal reason and the school rule; a contrast card separating the minimum age of sixteen from the under-nineteen school requirement.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described applicant can be licensed and what the school rule demands.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the two-document and three-document identification paths, the transfer bundle, what makes a document acceptable or rejected, and the primary and secondary lists.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each document rule; contrast cards for the photo versus non-photo paths and for primary versus secondary documents.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a set of documents and asking whether the bundle is accepted.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover Social Security number proof, the immigration stay rule and extra non-citizen documents, then the language and oral options for the knowledge test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for number proof, immigration papers and test options; a contrast card on the thirty-day stay rule versus a visa allowing a longer stay.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which proof or test option fits a described applicant.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the graduated license law, the learner license at fifteen and its strict companion rule, how that rule relaxes at sixteen, and how long a learner license lasts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the companion rule before and after sixteen and for the four-year term with its single renewal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz giving a learner's age and companion and asking whether the drive is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show the six-month holding gate to the road test, what passing changes, the motorcycle license classes, added restrictions and the vessel license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the road test gate, license classes and restrictions; contrast cards for the remaining term after the road test and the Class D versus Class M learner paths.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when a young driver may take the road test and which license class fits a vehicle.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec01-m01..sec01-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: License requirements, identification and learner licenses
License requirements, identification and learner licenses (confusables)

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
